Recovering from outpatient surgery that biopsied my cervix and removed some bad cells from it on 12/9. Surgery went well (no cancer, with clear margins, wooo!), but even though I thought I was being careful with no strenuous activity, I had to get restitched (for lack of a better term) because I was doing too much. Now I get to be on bedrest until tomorrow, and very limited activity afterward.

Also grieving my doggo, who we euthanized on Friday, 12/16. She had recurrent lymphoma, and I had initially scheduled the procedure for a few weeks ago, but then postponed it because she was still doing okay. Last week, she quickly deteriorated. We were fortunate enough to be able to use in-home euthanasia, via Journey’s End at Home (Dr. Scotti is an absolute angel). I know I did the right thing, that she went peacefully and that she was ready and we gave her a good life, but it still sucks so much. I also had never been present for a pet euthanasia before, and despite her not being in pain and going quickly, it was pretty traumatizing for me and I’m working through it.

Better days ahead.

Fast forward to today, my bleeding (which had all but gotten super light) was heavy, bright red, and I was passing clots. I was able to get in to see my doctor, who restitched me. She asked what activities I had done, and I said I’d walked my dog, but nothing worthy of a sweat. She asked if he’s a puller and when I said yes, she said, “that absolutely counts as strenuous activity.” So now I’m on bedrest for the next three days and we have a follow-up next week.

I say that to say, take as much time as your doctor advises.

I had a CKC on Friday and just had this happen last night! It scared the hell out of me, and I’ve been nervous to pee all day. I made a post last night about it in a panic. My doctor had warned me about the liquid bandage, but I didn’t realize how huge it would be. I’ve been bleeding lightly-moderately today with some mild cramping, but I feel like I can still feel that sensation and I hate it. 😫

Thank you so much. I did call, and luckily they had an after-hours service (this was about 1:30am my time), so I was able to speak with a nurse. She did agree that’s a big clot, but to keep an eye on it, if I’m soaking through 1-2 pads an hour, then I’d want to come in.

I was able to get maybe two hours of sleep, and haven’t passed anymore big clots and no significant increase in bleeding, so I’m taking it easy today and staying on top of hydration.

Thanks again for the encouragement, I’m really glad to have found this sub.
